evals.prompt: Scaffold reusable CI and cloud-run delivery for an existing Nautilus Rust 0.64 strategy with PostgreSQL, Redis Cache and S3 Parquet artifacts. Keep each experiment isolated; do not start infrastructure.
evals.expected_output: A non-executing deployment overlay and run plan, separate persistence roles, native feature/config wiring and explicit acceptance gaps.
assertions: Enables live/backtest streaming and persistence cloud at the appropriate Cargo boundaries and configures native streaming rather than relying on environment names alone.
Separates PostgreSQL run metadata, Redis Cache, Feather capture and Parquet/DataFusion; assigns one node/process and unique IDs/prefixes per independent run.
Does not execute migrations, image publication, cloud jobs or broker connections without authorization.
Rust 0.64 rejects LiveNodeConfig.streaming; sandbox/live capture requires async native writer integration, not the blocking built-in subscriber copied into the event loop.

evals.prompt: My Nautilus Rust node has streaming enabled but I cannot find Parquet for this run. Can I call CacheDatabaseAdapter::flush to make it durable and upload every event to an HTTP URL?
evals.expected_output: Explain Feather capture, explicit supported conversion/readback, destructive Redis flush semantics, and HTTP write limitations.
assertions: Identifies native Feather output and explicit convert_stream_to_data with a supported data name such as quotes, preserving ts_init.
Warns that Redis CacheDatabaseAdapter::flush delegates to destructive database flushing, not a buffered-write drain.
Does not assume HTTP is a writable durable sink or that all event families/custom payloads were captured.

evals.prompt: Fix a generic GitHub Actions YAML formatting error in a documentation-only repository with no Nautilus application.
evals.expected_output: Handle as generic CI formatting without selecting deployment or adding trading infrastructure.
assertions: Does not scaffold databases, object storage or a node.
Does not load Nautilus implementation guides for unrelated formatting.
